name: Biological Sciences - Cell Biology and Molecular Genetics PhD
detailsNote: Official annual information is available; Fall 2027 program dates were not explicitly confirmed. Admission model is not explicit.

applicationFee.note: International fee; domestic $50. Central policy denies ordinary waivers. Domestic-only October 19–26,2026 promotion has ended; no international promotion.

english.toefl: 94 iBT as published; confirm current test scale
english.note: PTE 65 also accepted. Exemptions depend on listed education countries or specified US/accredited study and other documented routes; written request to International Admissions required. Overseas English-medium study alone is not a general exemption.

documents: Copies of official transcripts; originals after admission
Personal statement with research experience/interests and potential faculty mentors
Three recommendations; at least one addresses research aptitude
International original-language academic records and certified English translation
requirements.note: Bachelor or higher, GPA 2.75 and strong biology/chemistry/mathematics; deficiencies addressed first year. Prior faculty contact not required. Program checklist requires faculty names.

funding.note: Unconditional admission includes assistantship, stipend, tuition coverage and some health insurance benefits without separate application; amount/duration not stated.
